value.value: Company guarantees the obligations of each Designated Borrower (Company Guaranty Agreement, Exhibit M). No collateral/security interest stated; facility is based on the Company's long-term, senior unsecured, non-credit-enhanced debt ratings.
value.note: verbatim: “"Company Guaranty Agreement" means the guarantee issued by the Company for the benefit of the Administrative Agent and the Banks substantially in the form of Exhibit M . ... The Obligations of the Company and each Designated Borrower shall be several in nature; provided that the Company shall guarantee the obligations of each Designated Borrower pursuant to a guaranty agreement substantially in the form of Exhibit M .”

value.value: Mandatory prepayment: Section 2.5.3(b) — if Total Outstandings exceed 105% of Aggregate Commitments due to exchange rate changes, prepay within 2 Business Days to not exceed 100% of Commitments. Events of Default (Article VII): 7.1 material misrepresentation; 7.2 nonpayment of principal when due / interest or fees within 5 Business Days; 7.3 breach of covenants (Sections 6.10, 6.11, 6.12, 6.14, 6.15; other breaches 30-day cure); 7.4 cross-default on Indebtedness over $200,000,000; 7.5/7.6 bankruptcy/insolvency; 7.8 unpaid judgments over $200,000,000; 7.9 ERISA Reportable Event/material Unfunded Liabilities; 7.10 Change in Control
value.note: verbatim: “If the Administrative Agent notifies the Company at any time that, as a result of a change in the applicable exchange rates relating to Alternative Currencies the Total Outstandings at such time exceed an amount equal to 105% of the Aggregate Commitments then in effect, then, within two (2) Business Days after receipt of such notice, the Company shall, or shall instruct one or more Borrowers to, prepay Loans in an aggregate amount sufficient to reduce such Outstanding Amount as of such date of payment to an amount not to exceed 100% of the aggregate Commitments then in effect ... The occurrence of any one or more of the following events shall constitute a Default: 7.1 Any representation or warranty ... shall be materially false ... 7.2 Nonpayment of principal ... 7.4 Failure ... to pay any Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount in excess of $200,000,000 ... 7.10 Any Change in Control shall occur.”

value.value: Applicable Facility Fee Rate: Level I 1.75 bps; Level II 2.0 bps; Level III 4.0 bps; Level IV 6.0 bps
value.note: verbatim: “"Applicable Facility Fee Rate" means, on any date and with respect to each Commitment whether used or unused, the applicable fee (in basis points) set forth below based on the Applicable Rating Level on such date: Applicable Rating Level Facility Fee Rate (in basis points) Level I 1.75 Level II 2.0 Level III 4.0 Level IV 6.0”

value.value: Base Rate plus Applicable Margin plus 2% per annum (for Term SOFR / Alternative Currency Advances, otherwise applicable rate including Applicable Margin plus 2% per annum)
value.note: verbatim: “any Advance not paid at maturity, whether by acceleration or otherwise, shall bear interest until paid in full at a rate per annum equal to the Base Rate plus the Applicable Margin, if any, applicable to Base Rate Loans plus 2% per annum”

value.value: Increase up to $500,000,000 in aggregate; minimum request $50,000,000
value.note: verbatim: “the Company may from time to time, request an increase in the Commitments by an amount (for all such requests) not exceeding $500,000,000; provided that any such request for an increase shall be in a minimum amount of $50,000,000.”

value.value: (a) acquisition (other than by the Knight Family) of 50% or more of outstanding Class B Common Stock; or (b) Knight Family fails to own and control 67% or more of outstanding Class A Common Stock
value.note: verbatim: “"Change in Control" means either (a) with respect to the Company's Class B Common Stock, the acquisition after the date of this Agreement by any Person or two or more Persons acting in concert, other than the Knight Family, of beneficial ownership ... of 50% or more of the outstanding shares of such Class B Common Stock; or (b) with respect to the Borrower's Class A Common Stock, if the Knight Family shall at any time fail to own and control 67% or more of the outstanding shares of such Class A Common Stock.”

value.value: Convert outstanding Loans into term loans due on first anniversary of Termination Date; fee of 0.50% times aggregate outstanding principal so converted
value.note: verbatim: “The Borrower may, upon notice to the Administrative Agent not later than the Termination Date, elect to convert all of the Loans outstanding on the Termination Date in effect at such time into “term loans” ... shall instead be due and payable on the first anniversary of the Termination Date ... the Borrower shall have paid to the Administrative Agent for the account of the Banks a fee in the amount equal to (x) 0.50% multiplied by (y) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of all Loans so converted.”

value.value: Section 6.12 negative pledge with enumerated exceptions; basket under 6.12.13 up to greater of $2,105,550,000.00 and 15% of consolidated net worth
value.note: verbatim: “6.12 Liens . The Company will not, nor will it permit any Subsidiary to, create, incur, or suffer to exist any Lien in, of or on the property of the Company or any Subsidiary, except: ... 6.12.13 Liens not otherwise permitted hereunder; provided that the aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness or other obligations secured thereby ... shall not at the time of incurrence exceed the greater of $2,105,550,000.00 and 15% of the consolidated net worth of the Company and its Subsidiaries”
